title.zh: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
title.en: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets

current_state.zh: Bitget 在热钱包被盗后已暂停提现，称受影响金额为 3.516 亿美元，冷钱包未受影响，事件由其超过 4.64 亿美元的用户保护基金覆盖。
current_state.en: Bitget has suspended withdrawals following a hot wallet breach, saying $351.6 million was affected, cold wallets were unaffected, and the incident is covered by its more than $464 million user protection fund.

updates.title_zh: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
updates.title_en: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
updates.what_changed_zh: Bitget confirmed a hack in which roughly $350 million in crypto was drained from its hot wallets, with on-chain data showing about $183 million in ETH, USDT, USDC, AVAX and BNB moved to a single address and a fresh wallet spending $19.67M in USDT0 to buy 7,111 ETH on Arbitrum, while the CEO said cold wallets stayed secure and losses are covered by the exchange's $464M User Protection Fund.

updates.title_zh: Bitget Suspends Withdrawals, Says $351.6 Million Affected In Hot Wallet Breach
updates.title_en: Bitget Suspends Withdrawals, Says $351.6 Million Affected In Hot Wallet Breach
updates.what_changed_zh: Bitget 已暂停提现，并披露此次热钱包被盗影响金额为 3.516 亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitget suspended withdrawals and disclosed that the hot wallet breach affected $351.6 million.
